newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends soft on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends soft on dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed low on commercial demand for dollars, after opening firm on the back of overseas weakness of the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.07 to the dollar, after opening at 57.05. The currency closed at 57.10 on Wednesday.

"The exchange rate travelled in a very narrow range. The upside was capped by the Central Bank top rate, and the downside was cushioned at about 57.03 by import covering demand," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
The Central Bank pushed down the dollar by 2.75 local cents, and fixed buying and selling at 55.9477 and 57.0776.
Overnight call money closed at its opening level of 13.5 percent, after moving in a narrow range between 13.25 percent and 15, dealers said.
